newsitem.title: SWITZERLAND: Swiss franc ends weaker in light holiday trade.
newsitem.headline: Swiss franc ends weaker in light holiday trade.

text.p: 1535 GMT - The Swiss franc ended a dull session slightly weaker against the dollar and mark. The U.S. unit put in new roughly 2-1/2 year highs against the Swiss franc but business was extremely thin, traders said.
The dollar ended below the day's high of 1.3536 Swiss francs, which was also the highest dollar/Swiss level since 1.3543 francs on July 29, 1994.
The mark was also stronger, getting as high as 86.94 Swiss centimes on Monday.
Mark/Swiss, at current levels, was near highs of December 1993 when it traded above 87.00 centimes, traders said.
Traders said activity was extremely thin, with many Swiss banks sidelined before year-end.
* Dollar ends at 1.3505/3515 Swiss francs vs 1.3480/3490 at Monday's open, and 1.3481/3486 at Friday's close.
* Mark ends at 86.79/82 Swiss centimes compared with 86.66/69 at Monday's open, and 86.68/71 at the close Friday.
